title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Financial Services Rollout & Pro Plan Subscription Freeze: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services powered by GPT-6 Astra, but announced a pause on new $200/mo Pro subscriptions as heavy inference demand stretches token capacity.

Millennium Math Prize Rumors Swirl Around AI Labs: Reports and insider rumors hint at imminent Millennium Prize developments, alleging OpenAI solved the Hodge Conjecture while Anthropic targeted Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer.

Major Security Leak Exposed in LLM API Routers: Security researcher Chaofan Shou revealed that 26 LLM routers have been leaking sensitive SSH keys, cloud credentials, and API tokens through unencrypted log routing.

US Treasury Signals New Sanctions & $6B Debt Buyback: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced upcoming sanctions on a major bank next week, while the Treasury prepared a $6 billion buyback of long-term government debt.

Ballon d'Or Buzz & Champions League Kickoff: Declan Rice publicly endorsed Harry Kane for the 2026 Ballon d'Or as Bayern Munich launched their Champions League campaign with a commanding home victory.
